heroHeadline: Ortega Declares End to Elections as OAS Convenes Emergency Session and New US Sanctions Bill Targets Regime's Gold Trade
heroSubtitle: Days after the OAS voted 29-1 to summon foreign ministers over Nicaragua's move to end elections, Sens. Cruz and Kaine introduce a bipartisan bill renewing sanctions and targeting the Ortega-Murillo government's gold sector and ties to Russia and Iran
